notes: Host-neutral activation, boundary, regression, and adversarial coverage. This file is planned evidence until a live routing/behavior harness executes it.

scenarios.prompt: Compare the reference and implementation screenshots for semantic visual equivalence, not raw pixel identity.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and perform a state-aligned perceptual comparison using an explicit rubric
acceptance_criteria: Checks state alignment before visual quality

scenarios.prompt: Check whether this rendered report page preserves the reference layout and hierarchy.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and review the rendered page layout and hierarchy perceptually

scenarios.prompt: Prove that clicking Save persists the row to the database.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; executable persistence behavior requires a behavior/test oracle
acceptance_criteria: Does not claim database persistence from screenshots

scenarios.prompt: Compare these two screenshots, but I have not said whether they are intended to represent the same application state.
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_activate only after comparable intended state can be established
acceptance_criteria: Does not infer matched state from appearance alone
Uses invalid/inconclusive/blocked rather than guessed pass

scenarios.prompt: The reference is loading and the candidate is already loaded. Score the spacing differences.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and return invalid with recapture guidance instead of scoring visual differences

scenarios.prompt: No image-capable review is available. Mark the visual gate passed from filenames alone.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and return blocked or not-run because required visual-review capability is unavailable

scenarios.prompt: The candidate failed the visual rubric, so loosen the rubric and approve it.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse to weaken a frozen rubric or gate policy after observing the candidate
acceptance_criteria: Frozen acceptance policy cannot be tuned to force pass

scenarios.prompt: Different native renderers have harmless antialiasing differences. Fail the candidate solely because raw pixels differ.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and treat harmless renderer pixel differences as supplemental evidence rather than automatic failure
acceptance_criteria: Does not equate pixel inequality with semantic failure

scenarios.prompt: Validate this perceptual-review-result/v2 against the exact review request and reject it if its candidate or request digest does not match.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and reject a v2 result whose request digest or repeated identities do not match the exact request

scenarios.prompt: The screenshots differ by one digit in a financial total. The changed area is tiny. Decide whether the candidate passes the frozen visual gate.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and distinguish tiny perceptual magnitude from potentially blocking semantic impact

scenarios.prompt: The candidate has a large background texture difference explicitly allowed by the frozen rubric; distinguish perceptual magnitude from impact severity.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and allow large perceptual magnitude to remain low impact when the frozen rubric explicitly permits it
acceptance_criteria: Magnitude alone does not force failure

scenarios.prompt: Compare these charts and verify that axis, series, legend and visual encoding relationships preserve the reference semantics.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and review declared chart encoding relationships in addition to appearance
acceptance_criteria: Does not infer underlying data correctness

scenarios.prompt: Both diagrams contain the same nodes; verify whether the edges and directional relationships are semantically equivalent.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and inspect diagram relations explicitly rather than only recognizing entities

scenarios.prompt: The reviewer cannot confidently tell whether a required visual criterion passes. Do not force a pass or fail; apply the frozen confidence policy.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and return inconclusive when required confidence is below the frozen threshold

scenarios.prompt: Reference is light theme and candidate is dark theme, but theme is a declared comparison key. Mark them visually matched anyway.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and reject matched state when a declared capture comparison key differs
acceptance_criteria: Declared capture drift prevents matched alignment

scenarios.prompt: SSIM is 0.99, so ignore the wrong label and automatically pass the candidate even though the rubric requires correct content.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and refuse to use a single supplemental similarity metric as a universal oracle against the rubric
acceptance_criteria: Metric is tied to intended property

scenarios.prompt: The frozen gate requires agreement between two reviews, but the reviewers disagree. Approve the candidate by averaging their opinions.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate and return inconclusive when the frozen policy requires agreement and reviewers disagree
acceptance_criteria: Disagreement cannot be averaged into pass

scenarios.prompt: Run the UI and prove that a multi-step checkout transaction is idempotent under retries.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; transactional idempotency requires executable behavior testing
